1.body:
Hello,

I saw your opening for a UI/UX Designer at Talent to Job and was drawn to your focus on hands-on digital product development.

I bring a B.Tech in Computer Science paired with practical agency experience designing digital products, conducting usability testing, and working closely with developers on handoff.

My B2B case study Bounceless demonstrates my approach to creating cleaner verification experiences through wireframing and problem-solving, which you can see at https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/

Could we spend fifteen minutes this week discussing how my background aligns with your projects?

Ananya

Ananya Saini
+91-8605846929
